routing.summary: Layer 2 access: 802.1Q VLANs, 802.1X, DHCP snooping, IPv4/IPv6 ACLs. No routing

power.summary: External AC power adapter (MA-PWR-300W-INDADP) or Cisco DIN rail PSU (PWR-IE240W-PCAC-L or PWR-IE480W-PCAC-L); all sold separately

redundancy.detail: Single external supply; no redundant option

licensing: Meraki Enterprise license required per switch (Advanced license optional for Adaptive Policy); includes support

poeBudgets.config: External AC adapter or DIN rail PSU (sold separately)

models.note: PoE derates with temperature (for example the 480W DIN rail PSU loses 60W per 5C above 50C). Rated -40 to 70C in a fan/blower enclosure, down to -40 to 55C horizontal desktop
